title: Firmware Release Runbook
author: 1a2b3c4d-0001-4a1b-8c2d-acme00000005
text:
# Firmware Release Runbook

Owner: Farah Haddad · Applies to: all AMR-7 units

## Release cadence
Firmware ships every Friday at 16:00 PT. The release manager pushes the new build to the whole fleet at once with `fleetctl release push --all`.

## Before the push
- QA signs off the build on the two bench units.
- Post the release notes in #eng-fleet.

## Rollback
If the pick error rate rises after the push, roll the whole fleet back with `fleetctl release rollback --all`.

title: AMR-7 Gripper Troubleshooting
author: 1a2b3c4d-0001-4a1b-8c2d-acme00000004
text:
# AMR-7 Gripper Troubleshooting

## Missed picks after a restart
Run `fleetctl gripper rehome <unit>` before the first wave. A permanent fix is tracked in ACME-210.

## Gripper stalls
Check the vacuum line for debris, then rerun the pick test.

title: Night Shift Onboarding
author: 1a2b3c4d-0001-4a1b-8c2d-acme00000002
text:
# Night Shift Onboarding

The shift runs 22:00-06:00. The shift lead (Bob Rivera) posts a handoff in #ops-night-shift at the end of every shift.

Charging docks 1-6 are on the east wall; every AMR-7 unit has a home dock printed on its chassis.
